key_findings: Hippocampal PTK2B (Pyk2) and PSD-95 are reduced in neuropathic pain mice with cognitive deficits.
Pyk2 overexpression restores spine density, PSD-95 and NMDAR2A and rescues cognition; Pyk2 and PSD-95 interact directly.
